messages:
elaine: Heads up - opening a small PR to update our SOC2 audit-log docs. Main changes: field renames in the exported schema (actor_id -> principal_id), add an explicit example for tenant_id separation, and a quick SDK snippet showing how to request de-identified exports. Can someone sanity-check wording before I land? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4827
manny: skimmed. two quick notes: 1) prefer "principal_id" over "user_principal" (consistency with other logs). 2) retention wording - we should call out "customer-controlled TTL" and legal-hold exception. small nit: the table header `actor_id` needs to match sample JSON.
elaine: thanks @manny - I'll align table header. For retention phrasing, draft line is: "Exports respect the tenant's retention policy (TTL) unless a legal hold is in effect; contact support for preservation requests." ok?
samir: quick SDK nit - in python snippet we introduced param `deidentify=true`. Can we change to `include_pii=false` (boolean clearer) and show how to set it in curl + python? Also add a note that deid is best-effort and PII redaction is not a substitute for customer-side redaction.
elaine: good catch. I'll switch to `include_pii=false` and add the caveat.
ashley: legal check: "legal hold" phrasing ok but avoid implying automated retention overrides. Suggest: "Exports will include records consistent with customer-configured TTLs; Redwood will preserve data if a customer provides a formal legal hold request, following our legal process." Also add link to legal-hold process doc.
elaine: noted. i'll use your sentence and link to /legal/processes/legal-hold
manny: sample JSON in the doc currently shows `actor_id: null` for system events. Could we show a real example where `principal_id` is `system-service`? helps integrators.
elaine: done - changed example. snippet now:

```json
{"timestamp":"2026-03-20T18:22:11Z","principal_id":"system-service","tenant_id":"t-012345","action":"model.load","details":{}}
```

samir: for python example show 2 lines: 1) public API call with include_pii=false 2) SDK path for on-prem/self-host where header `X-Redwood-Export-Mode: deidentified` is needed. keep them compact.
elaine: added both. curl example:

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/exports" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"t-012345","range":{"from":"2026-01-01","to":"2026-02-01"},"include_pii":false}'
```

python snippet:

```python
from redwood import AuditClient
client = AuditClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'])
client.create_export(tenant_id='t-012345', start='2026-01-01', end='2026-02-01', include_pii=False)
```

elaine: also added a short migration note for integrators: "If you rely on `actor_id`, rename to `principal_id`. Both will be accepted for 90 days in the export API, with `principal_id` preferred." Thoughts?
ashley: sounds fine. legal suggests 90 days is okay, but flag in the docs where to contact support if they need a longer compat window.
manny: small docs QA: add a link to the SDK reference for AuditClient and update the cross-link to "retention and legal hold" page.
elaine: done. I also added a changelog bullet and a contact line: `support@redwood.ai`. If nobody objects I'll merge after CI passes. :thumbsup:
docs-bot: build status - docs CI passed for PR #4827 :white_check_mark:
samir: +1 from me, especially after include_pii rename.
ashley: +1 from legal on the final wording.
manny: +1. go ahead.
elaine: merging in 10m, will follow up if any follow-on edits come in. thanks all!
